messages:
sam: Quick heads-up — ran a 1h perf sweep on paged-KV + Flash variants (flash-attn-v1/v2, fused). Noticing a periodic latency spike under steady qps (sawtooth pattern). Dump below.

perf-ci-bot: Benchmark run 2141590000-01 completed. Summary: p95 increased from 24ms -> 110ms every ~60s under sustained 4k qps.

jin: do you have flame graph? could be GC or eviction churn

sam: attaching small excerpt:
```
[2026-03-18T09:12:04Z] inflight: 4200 tokens/s p95=28ms
[2026-03-18T09:13:04Z] inflight: 4300 tokens/s p95=112ms kv-pager-evict=high
[2026-03-18T09:14:04Z] inflight: 4150 tokens/s p95=30ms kv-cache-hit=0.72
```

maya: that's ... periodic. Could be background compaction or allocator sweeps in block table

alex: another hypothesis: kernel chooser bouncing between fused vs flash paths due to sequence-length histogram changes inside batching window. Fused good for short seq, flash good for long; if batch mixes it toggles which kernels are used and causes stalls w/ kernel load

sam: I instrumented kernel_choice count:
`chooser: fused=924, flash=321, fallback=12` but when p95 spikes fused->flash flip increases

jin: how is batching policy? dynamic batching cap? If we have a ramp-up token burst every 60s maybe batching queues coalesce longer seqs

maya: current batch heuristic: max_batch_tokens = min(8192, inflight_avg*2)

alex: suggests change: prefer sticky kernel selection per batch window. If >60% of sequences in a batch are short, lock fused for that batch; otherwise flash. Avoid per-request toggling. Also add a micro-delay (0.5ms) to let batch settle — saves cold kernel loads

sam: ran a quick patch locally (sticky chooser + 0.5ms settle) — p95 flatlined to 32ms, no sawtooth on 15m run. Will push perf branch.

perf-ci-bot: New run 2141590000-02 queued (branch: sticky-chooser)

jin: we should also look at KV pager allocation: when eviction spikes, pager IO blocks kernel threads. Maybe prefetch hot entries or increase slab retention for hot blocks

maya: current block table alloc strategy: hybrid-slab (grow-on-demand) with aggressive free after 30s idle. Change to LRU-protected hot set with 120s for items with hit_rate>0.6

sam: agreed. Action items:
- sam -> perf branch: sticky kernel chooser + 0.5ms settle (PR: sticky-chooser)
- maya -> perf branch: adapt block-table retention rules, hot-set protect (PR: kv-retain-hot)
- alex -> add chooser telemetry: per-batch histogram of seq_len, kernel chosen, kernel-load ms
- jin -> run extended 4k qps soak 2h after patches

alex: one more: add a counter for kernel-switches/sec and correlate with GPU kernel launch stalls (nvprof trace)

sam: I'll post raw nvprof snippets on the PR

maya: tl;dr — likely combo of kernel-flapping + KV eviction IO. Next run should confirm. :thumbsup:

sam: bumping to @eng-runtime for visibility :eyes:

ops-bot: created ticket RINF-5321 'Investigate periodic p95 spikes — kernel chooser & kv retention' assigned to sam/jin/maya

sam: thanks. Will update here with run 02 results.
